notes: Every unit listed in contacts/totals is ALIVE as of data_age_s.
Kills, losses and deaths come ONLY from recent_kills_and_losses / my_shots / my_kills. A kill with confidence confirmed is a kill (say splash, no 'likely'); only confidence likely is 'likely'.
Mission totals come from kill_tallies / my_kills_this_mission, never recent lists. For fresh confirmations use my_kills_recent seq after your last confirmation cursor.
clock is relative to Prometheus' nose (12 = ahead).
Each group/airbase 'call' is the ready radio call in the required order; read it as written.
picture_top3 = the three closest hostile air groups within 50 nm, verbatim. No extra-group count.
Traffic means aircraft (including helos), not ground units. Use air_traffic and airbase traffic.
Never say overhead unless the contact has overhead_allowed true (within 3 nm).

cockpit = live data from Prometheus' own aircraft (DCS Export.lua, about 5 per second): config, flight, payload, warning_lights; rwr/locked_target only when cockpit.rwr.available is true (no module has exported them so far). Fuel: ownship.fuel.
